meta.name: Pen15
meta.description:
Middle school as it really happened. Maya Erskine and Anna Konkle star in this adult comedy, playing versions of themselves as thirteen-year-old outcasts in the year 2000, surrounded by actual thirteen-year-olds, where the best day of your life can turn into your worst with the stroke of a gel pen.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 8 Feb 2019 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: The Lonely Island, AwesomenessTV, Party Over Here · Network: Hulu

Not complete. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 7/15 (missing E8-15)

On your server — Audio: English

links.name: Wet Hot American Summer Ten Years Later

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: It’s the first day of seventh grade in the year 2000. School rejects, Anna and Maya, get a lot of unexpected attention.

videos.title: Miranda
videos.overview: Maya and Anna become fascinated with the mature girls in their class who smoke. They are faced with the age-old question: stay home and play pretend or go out and do drugs?

videos.title: Ojichan
videos.overview: Maya feels a tickle down there which becomes kind of an addiction, distracting her from her best friend who really needs her.

videos.title: Solo
videos.overview: Trailview’s Night of Amazing Music is coming up. Anna hopes to win Alex’s heart with a classical aria while Maya is consumed with a lie.

videos.title: Community Service
videos.overview: There’s an exclusive fashion show at the local nursing home. Somehow Anna and Maya make it in, but feelings of inadequacy lead them down a shady path.

videos.title: Posh
videos.overview: Maya gets a questionable nickname during a school project. Anna goes along with it, resulting in a test of their friendship and identities.

videos.title: AIM
videos.overview: Maya and Anna get their very first AIM screennames and their social world opens up. Maybe too much.

videos.title: Wild Things
videos.overview: It’s a viewing party to watch the newly released VHS movie, Wild Things. The night gets sexy and Anna and Maya try to keep up.

videos.title: Anna Ishii-Peters
videos.overview: Anna gets to sleep over at Maya’s house on a school night and can’t wait to become part of the Ishii-Peter family. But things turn as Anna gets a little too comfortable.

videos.title: Dance
videos.overview: It’s the night of their first school dance but Anna and Maya are on bad terms. They’ll have to navigate this unfamiliar terrain set to billboard hits, by themselves.

videos.title: Pool
videos.overview: Two days after the dance, Maya and Anna reluctantly go to a lame pool party. A crush unexpectedly shows up, causing them to question their sanity and reputations.

videos.title: Wrestle
videos.overview: Maya zeros in on her crush, while Anna deals with the fallout from her parents’ divorce. Together they find outlets in an unexpected extracurricular activity.

videos.title: Vendy Wiccany
videos.overview: Anna and Maya discover secret powers within, allowing them to control rocky aspects of their lives through magic.

videos.title: Three
videos.overview: Witnessing their daughters reach a new low, Kathy and Yuki rally around them. At school, Maya and Anna receive an opportunity at redemption but it will come with a range of influences.

videos.title: Sleepover
videos.overview: Maura hosts a group sleepover at her house. The clock chimes late into the night as secrets and masks threaten the death of friendships.

videos.title: Play
videos.overview: The school play has been cast. Maya has the opportunity to get her actual first kiss. Anna struggles to find herself.

videos.title: Opening Night
videos.overview: It’s opening night. Hearts are exposed, forcing both Anna and Maya to grow up.
